Pre Conditions:

Title: Verify that a maker can successfully propose a merge operation when the pre-flight check passes
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- A conflict exists in the "New" tab
- Neither account has wallet or transaction history on the existing account (pre-flight check will pass)
- Maker is logged into admin panel with maker permissions
Postconditions:
Post Conditions:
The following should be true after test completion:
- A PENDING operation exists with payload containing reportId, resolvedInFavorOfUserId (winner), and losingUserId (loser)
- Conflict has moved from "New" to "Waiting for Approval"
- No merge has executed yet — awaiting checker approval
Tags: Customer Account Management; Milestone 2;   Merge; Identity Conflicts

Step Action: Open the conflict detail and select "Merge accounts"
Step Expected: Merge flow initiated — maker is prompted to select the winner

Step Action: Select the winner account (account to keep)
Step Expected: Pre-flight check runs automatically

Step Action: Observe pre-flight check result
Step Expected: Check passes — no error 1005. Maker can proceed to review and submit

Step Action: Enter resolution notes (minimum 5 characters, e.g. "TRN verified — merging accounts")
Step Expected: Notes accepted

Step Action: Submit the merge proposal
Step Expected: Operation created with type: id-conflict-resolution-merge-user, status: PENDING, priority: HIGH

Step Action: Navigate to "Waiting for Approval" tab
Step Expected: The conflict now appears under "Waiting for Approval"

Title: Verify that archiving an account does NOT auto-clear TRN_DUPLICATED on the remaining account
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- A conflict exists between Target and Existing accounts (both in TRN_DUPLICATED)
- Maker has proposed Archive on one account and checker has approved
- The remaining (non-archived) account is still in TRN_DUPLICATED state
Postconditions:
Post Conditions:
The following should be true after test completion:
- Archiving one account does not cascade a state change to the other
- Admin must take a separate action (e.g. Reset KYC) to unblock the remaining account
- Archived account is excluded from future TRN duplicate detection
Tags: Customer Account Management; Milestone 2;  Archive; Edge Case; Identity Conflicts

Step Action: Verify the archived account's state after approval
Step Expected: Account is archived (soft-deleted, data retained, not accessible to user)

Step Action: Verify the remaining account's kycStatus
Step Expected: kycStatus is still TRN_DUPLICATED — archive did NOT auto-resolve the duplicate state

Step Action: Log in as the remaining account user
Step Expected: Login succeeds but KYC-gated actions still blocked

Step Action: Admin performs Reset KYC on the remaining account
Step Expected: TRN_DUPLICATED cleared — user can re-enter KYC flow
